description: §21.3.1 — an `import:host` written inside a `${}` logic block fires E-IMPORT-003 exactly once: unlike a plain `import`, `import:host` is valid ONLY at file top level, outside any `${}` context. (No manifest governs the case, so E-IMPORT-008 also fires.)
rationale: §21.3.1: "import:host SHALL appear only at file top level, OUTSIDE any ${} logic context. An import:host declaration inside a ${} block or any nested scope SHALL be a compile error (E-IMPORT-003 — same as plain import)."
